subject: Archer field schema discrepancy — CAIQ export and temp-cred upload cadence
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novapay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-23 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Archer onboarding — CAIQ export schema mismatch

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the Archer invite. We exported our CAIQ responses to share, but the file looks different than the sample mapping you shared during kickoff. A couple of immediate items:

- Our CAIQ export has nested sections (e.g., 'controls -> control_metadata -> evidence_files') while Archer expects flat field keys per control.
- We include hashed object references (S3 URIs) instead of discrete file names in some fields.
- We will need a short-lived upload mechanism for our evidence staging S3 (security policy requires ephemeral credentials).

Attaching the CAIQ export (novapay_caiq_export_v2.xlsx) and a short dump of our evidence index. Can you confirm if Redwood will perform a transform or if we should reformat on our side? Also please share preferred temp-credential TTL and any required object naming conventions for Archer.

Appreciate the help — want to avoid rework on our side if there's a mapping script you already use.

Best,
Liam
Security Engineer, NovaPay
security@novapay.com

Attachments: novapay_caiq_export_v2.xlsx (excel), evidence_index_sample.txt (text)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novapay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-23 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — CAIQ export schema mismatch

Hi Liam — thanks for the export and the clear notes. Short answers up front:

- We can accept either (A) a flattened CSV with one row per control and explicit evidence filenames, or (B) your nested CAIQ export and we'll run a one-time transform.
- For evidence objects stored in S3, we prefer a stable manifest (CSV) that maps control_id -> s3_uri; we will not re-host artifacts.
- For temporary credentials we can provide pre-signed PUTs or short-lived IAM creds via our onboarding script. Default TTL we propose is 2 hours for uploads; we can extend to 8 hours for high-volume migrations but would need a sign-off from your security team.

Jonas/Ben — can you confirm the transform steps and whether we have a reusable script for nested CAIQ->flat mapping? Marissa — can you add the Archer field map template to the shared drive and outline the manifest columns we expect?

Liam — attaching Archer field template (archer_field_map_v1.csv) to show the target layout. If you prefer we run the transform, please confirm a maintenance window for the uploads (we generally recommend a low-traffic window to minimize exporter throttling).

Thanks,
Mina
Sr. Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: archer_field_map_v1.csv (csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novapay.com>
Date: 2028-08-23 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — CAIQ export schema mismatch

Thanks — dug into the export Liam attached. Quick technical notes (so we have a single source of truth):

1) Field mapping specifics

- Your export uses 'control_id' at controls.level and nests 'evidence_files' as an array of objects with keys 'uri' and 'hash'. Archer's ingestion expects 'control_id' and a comma-separated 'evidence_filenames' field.

- Proposed map (what our script will output): control_id, control_title, evidence_filenames (csv), evidence_uris (csv), last_modified_utc. We keep both filenames and URIs so your provenance is preserved.

2) Transform plan

- We have a reusable Python transform (archer_transform.py) that flattens CAIQ v4 exports -> Archer CSV. It handles nested arrays and normalizes S3 URIs to filenames when the filename can be inferred; otherwise it leaves the original URI in evidence_uris.

- Running transform is non-destructive. We'll produce a preview CSV and a checksums report for you to validate.

3) Temporary credentials and upload cadence

- Option A: Pre-signed PUTs we generate per object (no IAM creds exchanged). TTL: 2 hours by default. Upload concurrency: recommend 10 parallel uploads per client to avoid rate limits.

- Option B: Short-lived IAM credentials via STS with MFA session tag. TTL: 4 hours; needs your security approval.

4) Security controls and audit

- All pre-signed URLs are single-use and logged. We will supply an upload manifest that includes expected Content-MD5 checksums. After ingest, we run an integrity verification step.

Next steps

- Mina / Marissa: I'll drop the transform preview and the archer_transform.py README in the shared drive link Jon provided.

- Liam: Tell us whether you want Redwood to run the transform (we will need an upload window) or if NovaPay prefers to produce the flattened CSV. If you choose to run uploads via pre-signed URLs, confirm any client-side throttling rules we should accommodate.

-Jonas
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachments: archer_transform_readme.md (text), transform_preview_sample.csv (csv)

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novapay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-24 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — CAIQ export schema mismatch

Hi team — thanks for the clear plan and options. NovaPay prefers Redwood run the transform and provide pre-signed PUTs for object ingestion (Option A). A few clarifications before we schedule:

- TTL: 2 hours is acceptable for the initial run. We'll open a maintenance window tomorrow 02:00–05:00 UTC for the upload.
- Concurrency: we'll use 6 parallel upload threads from our side; please ensure the pre-signed URLs will not be invalidated if we retry within the TTL window.
- Audit: we'll want the upload manifest + checksums prior to the window so we can run a matching process.

Please send the preview CSV and upload manifest as soon as available and confirm the Drive link for the transform artifacts. Once we validate the preview, we will trigger the upload during the window.

Cheers,
Liam
NovaPay Security

Attachments referenced: tempcreds_upload_instructions.pdf (pdf)
